title: Demo tenant: one-command reset + healthcheck with clear pass/fail output for SEs
creator: Markus Klein
description:
Goal: Sales Engineering needs a single, reliable command to (a) reset the demo tenant to a known-good state and (b) validate the environment is healthy before a live call. Output must be unambiguous (PASS/FAIL + actionable next steps) and fast enough to run while an AE is doing intro slides.

Why: We’ve repeatedly hit brittle failure modes during live demos (quota 429s, expired/scoped keys, RBAC mapping issues, pinned model availability changes, empty Console graphs due to missing synthetic events). SE feedback in Slack: reset takes too long, unclear when it’s “ready,” and too many manual checks.

Scope:
- CLI command(s) used by SEs from a laptop + optional CI runner.
- Healthcheck must validate the demo environment end-to-end (control plane + runtime route availability + telemetry ingestion freshness).
- Reset must be safe (cannot run against non-demo tenants) and idempotent.

Non-goals:
- Building a dedicated UI in Console.
- Automating every enterprise/security screenshot flow (handled separately in enablement artifacts).
acceptance_criteria:
1) Provide a single command that SEs can run to reset the demo environment to a known-good baseline in <= 5 minutes (p95 on a normal day).
2) Provide a single command that SEs can run to perform a healthcheck in <= 60 seconds.
3) Healthcheck returns explicit PASS/FAIL and prints remediation hints (e.g., "quota low -> run quota bump preset" / "dashboards empty -> run synthetic traffic job").
4) Commands are protected by safety rails: (a) only runs for allowlisted demo org IDs, (b) requires explicit confirmation or env guard, (c) rate-limited to prevent repeated resets during parallel demos.
5) Healthcheck validates at minimum:
   - Auth: scoped key works + correct org/project access
   - Quotas/rate limits: enough headroom for a 30 min demo
   - Model pins: pinned model versions exist and are READY in primary region; fallback variant is READY
   - Routes: chat completions streaming path succeeds; structured output path succeeds; tool-calling example succeeds
   - Telemetry: ingestion pipeline is receiving events; dashboards should not be empty for default time range
6) Documented in the Demo Tenant Reset Runbook with copy/paste steps and expected output.
7) Emit structured logs/metrics for reset/healthcheck runs (so we can debug demo issues and measure time-to-ready).
implementation_notes:
CLI entry points:
- `rw demo reset --project <demo-project> [--preset standard|fast]`
- `rw demo healthcheck --project <demo-project> [--region us-east-1]`

Design choices:
- Reset is idempotent and uses the same underlying bootstrap primitives as demo provisioning (create-if-missing; update routes to pinned versions; rotate demo keys if requested).
- Healthcheck is read-only and runs a small, bounded set of synthetic requests (with tiny token budgets) against the demo routes.
- Healthcheck uses a dedicated control-plane endpoint for the heavier checks (quota snapshot, pinned model readiness, telemetry freshness) so SE laptops don’t need internal DB access.

Healthcheck checks (implemented):
A) Control plane
- Confirm org/project IDs are in demo allowlist
- Verify role mapping: caller has `demo.se` role and can list routes + keys
- Quota headroom: tokens/min + req/min thresholds (configurable)

B) Runtime + routes
- `chat.completions` streaming smoke test (abort after first chunk)
- Structured output: JSON schema constrained response returns valid JSON
- Tool calling: deterministic tool-call response (ensures function calling plumbing)
- Routing policy dry-run: verifies fallback configuration exists and target models are compatible

C) Telemetry + Console readiness
- Confirm last ingestion timestamp within 10 minutes for demo project
- Confirm at least N requests and non-zero token counts in the last hour
- If empty: print the exact command to start the synthetic traffic generator

Output format (example):
- Human:
  - `PASS  auth` / `FAIL quotas` (with reason)
  - Summary line: `OVERALL: FAIL (2/9 checks failed)`
- Machine:
  - `--json` prints a flat JSON line per check for piping into internal dashboards.

Safety rails:
- Hard allowlist of demo org IDs + environment guard `REDWOOD_DEMO_MODE=1`
- Interactive confirmation unless `--yes` is provided
- Rate limit resets per org (server-side): 1 per 5 minutes
- Prominent banner in output: shows org/project/region being targeted before any mutation.

Observability:
- Emit `demo_reset_duration_seconds` and `demo_healthcheck_result` with tags (org, project, region, preset, caller).
- Log correlation ID printed to stdout so SRE can trace a failed run quickly.
rollout_plan:
1) Ship CLI behind internal feature flag `demo_cli_v1` and test with SE pilot group (Markus + SE leads).
2) Add runbook instructions + train SEs during enablement session.
3) Remove flag after 2 weeks of stable use; keep allowlist permanent.
4) Monitor metrics: reset time p50/p95, healthcheck failure rate, most common failing checks.

Rollout comms:
- Post in #sales and #sales-engineering with a 60s copy/paste snippet.
- Add to demo checklist docs as the first pre-flight step.
qa_plan:
Dry run checklist (required before marking Done):
- Run `rw demo reset` twice back-to-back; second run must be a no-op or minimal changes (idempotent).
- Induce quota failure by lowering quota preset; healthcheck must FAIL and recommend quota bump preset.
- Induce dashboard emptiness by disabling synthetic traffic job; healthcheck must FAIL and recommend starting generator.
- Temporarily break pinned model reference in staging demo tenant; healthcheck must FAIL with pinned model readiness details.
- Validate rate limiting: multiple resets in < 5 minutes should be blocked with clear message.

Regression coverage:
- Add CI job that runs healthcheck nightly against demo tenant and posts to demo-oncall channel on FAIL.
risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: Accidental reset of non-demo tenants.
- Mitigation: server-side allowlist + env guard + interactive confirmation + explicit org/project echo.

Risk: Healthcheck causes noisy demo metrics or costs.
- Mitigation: bounded token budgets + tag healthcheck traffic; exclude from headline dashboards via filter.

Risk: Healthcheck becomes flaky due to transient capacity.
- Mitigation: retries with jitter for route smokes; treat transient failures as WARN once before FAIL; leverage fallback route readiness checks.

updates:
2025-11-18 (Markus): Created after multiple SE requests for a single command + clear readiness signal; current runbook is too manual.
2025-12-03 (Devon): Drafted CLI surface area. Proposed splitting reset vs healthcheck commands to keep healthcheck safe/read-only.
2025-12-12 (Sean): Requested explicit SLO checks (quota headroom + ingestion freshness) and correlation ID in output for on-call debugging.
2026-01-07 (Devon): Implemented allowlist guard + interactive confirmation. Reset preset `standard` seeds baseline routes + prompt sets; `fast` skips non-critical seed.
2026-01-22 (Markus): Pilot feedback: healthcheck output needs to be more directive (exact next commands). Also need streaming smoke test to catch EU disconnect issue early.
2026-02-04 (Devon): Added PASS/FAIL summary with remediation lines; added --json output. Wired server-side rate limiting for reset.
2026-02-12 (Markus): Verified end-to-end in demo tenant; runbook updated; ready for broad SE rollout.
comments: Sean Gallagher (SRE): Please ensure healthcheck doesn’t rely on Console UI state; validate telemetry freshness via ingestion API and make the UI a secondary symptom. Also add metrics so we can see how often people run reset right before a demo.
Ethan Park (Control plane/auth): For safety rails, avoid client-only checks. Allowlist must be enforced server-side in the reset endpoint, not just the CLI.
Allison Grant (Observability): Tag healthcheck traffic (`source=demo_healthcheck`) so we can filter from cost/latency slides if needed. We should still keep it visible for debugging.
Markus Klein (SE): The big win is a binary answer: “can I demo in the next 2 minutes?” Make sure failures print the exact command to fix (quota preset, synthetic traffic generator, key rotation).
